name: Pre Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students
benefit:
Scholarship for 10 months: ₹ 225 per month for Day Scholars; ₹ 525 per month for Hostellers.
Books and Ad hoc Grant: ₹ 750 per annum for Day Scholars; ₹ 1000 per annum for Hostellers.
Additional Allowances for  Person with Disability (PwD) studying in private unaided Schools - 
Reader Allowance for Blind students: ₹160.
Transport Allowance for students with disabilities (as defined in the Persons
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class 9th or Class 10th.
1. The applicant must be from Scheduled Tribe.
1. The Total Annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹ 2.50 Lakh per Annum.
1. The applicant must not be availing of any other scholarship by the govt.
